account_change: Add glc_manage_plugins to the existing SEO manager account confirmed by the owner; do not change its role or other capabilities.
host_changes: Mount data/plugins at /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins, retaining any existing third-party plugins before replacing the container.
Set GLC_ALLOW_PLUGIN_MANAGEMENT=1 for the WordPress service.
Keep installer staging writable and inaccessible over HTTP; keep WordPress and Geolander Core files root-owned.
preserve: Existing production database and uploads volume
Published URLs, SEO and locale metadata, rating settings and reviews
All existing accounts, bookings and partner assignments
Existing third-party plugin files and activation state
rollback: Restore the backed-up compose/code files and start the retained rollback image. Do not restore the database to roll back code. Remove only the newly granted glc_manage_plugins capability if reverting the permission change.
